name: Adams County, PA
findings: Adams County has 325 nonprofit organizations. 174 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 147 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Adams County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 14 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do social and fraternal organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Education organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 9 education organizations here list membership, compared with about 4 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do education organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Adams County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
